notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear friends![/h3]

[h3]A bunch of cutscenes have been added to the game, intro + victory cutscene for each location, as well as some bonus ones! We also fixed some minor bugs.[/h3]

[h3]Now you can watch any cutscene through the main menu![/h3]

[list]
[*] [h3]Help Emperor Vladimir Defend Saint Petersburg from the Lizards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/02a426241889e962032e7aec2213fca6b72af420.png[/img]
[*] [h3]The United Lizard Flotillas of Nibiru and Mars have attacked Earth! Go on a journey and destroy the lizard bases![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/f8a25b24e07620286d40829d048e0aec10c047bb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/94e4f4af6e7a5761beac62092cef5abd54c33dec.png[/img]
[*] [h3]Celebrate the New Year 2024 with Emperor Vladimir, God Perun and the knights - Billyslav Herringtonov and Ivan Darkholmov[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/c483ecae1effbfbee64c2ee700eab6b4927016e6.png[/img]
[*] [h3]Go to Sauna with the Great Russian Knights ♂[/h3]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/dff632b809b7f1514c4e5358c92ffca5b114ba26.png[/img]

[h3]And more other cutscenes![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/8abb4194e6169b0319cca21941dc0b5178580ca1.png[/img]

[h3]Play and if you like it, please tell all your friends if you haven't already! And also we remind you that the game has a 40% discount, give your friends a great gift for the new year! Thanks![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763951/6b3b22420da5fa4a662a23293582cd22cf51cdd4.png[/img]
